questions.question: Paul told Timothy that elders who lead well deserve double honor. Which of these elders deserve it especially?

answers.text: Those who work hard at preaching and teaching
Those who have served in the church the longest
Those who were the first ones chosen to lead

questions.question: Paul told Timothy to rebuke church leaders who keep on sinning in front of everyone. Why?

answers.text: So the others will stand in fear of sin
So the elders can vote on what happens next
So the one in sin can explain himself

questions.question: Paul told Timothy to be quick about the laying on of hands. True or false?
Paul told believers living under slavery to honor their masters. What reason did he give?

answers.text: So God's name and the teaching aren't discredited
So they can earn their freedom much sooner
So their masters will come to believe in God
